method.automated: Concurrent HTTPS GET with browser user-agent and a small byte range against every sources.json URL.
method.content: Retained facts were checked during research against the named official page, report table/section, abstract, or DOI record. Headline interpretations additionally have three-part audits in source-verification.json.
method.interpretation: HTTP 403, a local certificate-chain failure, or environment DNS failure is an automation exception and not evidence that a source is nonexistent. HTTP 404 is treated as broken and corrected or removed.

corrected.old_url_result: HTTP 404 for a retired fact-sheet path
corrected.content_adjustment: The live official page supports up to 27.5 Mgal/d and deep-well concentrate disposal. An 83 percent recovery value from the retired fact sheet was removed because it was not present on the replacement page.

automation_exceptions.resolution: Existence and retained content were checked through direct browser/official or DOI records; keep a browser-based link checker for production QA.
